instruction.vi: Chuẩn bị 1 phút rồi nói 1–2 phút; ghi âm và tự nghe lại.

questions.prompt_en: Describe a journey you remember well. You should say: where you went; how you travelled; what happened; why it was memorable.
questions.prompt_vi: Part 2: chuẩn bị 60 giây, nói tối đa 2 phút.

answer.model_en: A journey I remember well was a weekend trip to a coastal town with two friends. We decided to go by coach because none of us wanted to drive for several hours. We booked our tickets online and left early on Saturday morning. At first, the journey was fairly ordinary. We talked about our plans and watched the countryside through the windows. However, there was heavy rain along the route, so the coach arrived later than expected. Instead of getting annoyed, we used the extra time to decide which places we really wanted to visit. When we finally reached the town, the rain had almost stopped. We walked along the beach, tried some local food and took photographs near the harbour. The following morning, we rented bicycles and explored a quieter area outside the centre. My favourite moment was stopping at a small café and looking out over the sea while everyone else was still waking up. I remember this trip because it was simple but relaxing. We had not planned every detail, and the delay actually made us more flexible. It also reminded me that travelling with good friends can be enjoyable even when things do not go exactly as expected.

questions.explanation_vi: Mẫu chỉ để tham khảo, không bắt buộc học thuộc. Đối chiếu bốn tiêu chí nói.

phases.utterance_vi: Bạn sẽ có một phút chuẩn bị và tối đa hai phút nói. Hãy ghi từ khóa thay vì viết cả câu.
Ghi một ý cho từng gạch đầu dòng, sau đó nghĩ thêm một chi tiết hoặc ví dụ.
Nói tự nhiên; nếu bí ý, dùng một câu chuyển ý rồi nói tiếp.
Kiểm tra đã nói đủ ý, có ví dụ cụ thể và dùng thì phù hợp chưa. Mẫu chỉ để tham khảo, không bắt buộc học thuộc.
